data.name: Charanjeet
data.gender_notes: Charanjeet is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Charanjeet is a Sanskrit name composed of two words: Charan (feet) and Jeet (victorious). It is a name given to a boy who is believed to be victorious in battles and over obstacles. It is a name deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is considered auspicious and powerful. The name Charanjeet carries the meaning “Victorious in battle” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Charanjeet usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious in battle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Overcoming obstacles with courage and wisdom
data.etymology: Charanjeet belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious in battle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charanjeet total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Charanjeet is associated with strength, courage, and triumph in battles and over life's challenges. In Hindu mythology, gods such as Hanuman and Rama are often depicted as having the ability to overcome any obstacle through the power of their feet and divine strength. The name is a reminder of these heroic figures, and inspires those who bear it to persevere and overcome challenges with determination and victory.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Charanjeet highlights the concept of the divine within each individual. It suggests that we all possess the power and strength to conquer our inner demons and overcome obstacles on our spiritual journey. The name serves as a reminder to stay steadfast in our journey towards self-realization and spiritual growth, and to see each challenge as an opportunity to develop our inner strength and resilience. Through the power of this name, we can aspire to live a life of dharma (duty) and righteousness, and ultimately, attain moksha (liberation from the cycle of birth and death).

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Charanjeet remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
